title: kanban: a refused card move is announced to screen readers as a success ("Moved CARD to COLUMN.") — the drop announcement fires before the write settles
body:
Filing gate: ① — product defect with a reproduction (user-visible, assistive-technology channel).

Path: ux-conventions.write-feedback
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24570 · ux-conventions.write-feedback · acceptance[3]
Checklist priority: P1 (the item fails on this clause ⇒ inherit P1)
type: Bug — violates the declared write-feedback contract (a refused write never shows success feedback)
Reader who acts: the objectui dev seat that takes this card from triage — the fix is in `packages/plugin-kanban`.
Dup check (open + closed): objectui issues searched "kanban drag announcement live region moved refused move screen reader" → 4 hits, all closed and adjacent, none this defect: #12716 (announcements added — raw ids before), #12837 (Space instruction without a keyboard sensor), #11802 (form designer ids), #4138 (rollback on rejected drag with external data). objectstack-ai/objectstack search on the same terms: 0 relevant.

reach: on a stock showcase boot, dragging a To Do card onto Done answers `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID` → 400 `Invalid task status transition.`, and the board's live region reads `Moved CARD to Done.` (measured at objectui 4016370af3c9, the console pinned by framework 5b14b7f3).

## Reproduction

1. Boot the showcase (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`), sign in as admin.
2. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/showcase_task.board`.
3. Drag a card from Backlog or To Do onto Done with real pointer events. The task state machine (`task_status_flow`) refuses that transition.
4. Network: `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID` body `{"status":"done"}` → **400**. The visible UI is correct: error toast "Invalid task status transition.", the card reverts, a re-read shows the status unchanged.
5. Read the dnd-kit live region (`role=status`, `aria-live=assertive`, `DndLiveRegion-0`, visually hidden): it holds **"Moved CARD to Done."**

Expected: a refused move is not announced as a completed move. Actual: a screen-reader user hears that the move happened, then (only visually) the error. Reproduced 3× on fresh loads with real pointer events.

## Mechanism

`packages/plugin-kanban/src/kanbanDndAnnouncements.ts` — `onDragEnd` returns `t('kanban.dnd.moved', …)` whenever the drop target's column differs from the card's home column. It runs synchronously at drop time, before the write's answer exists, so the announcement cannot reflect a refusal. (`KanbanImpl.tsx` defines `'kanban.dnd.moved': 'Moved {{card}} to {{column}}.'`.)

## Fix direction (for the implementer to choose)

Announce neutrally at drop (the existing `kanban.dnd.dropped` shape, or nothing) and announce the outcome when the write settles — the move on success, the server's refusal reason on failure — through the same live region the board already owns. Pin it with a test that drives a rejected move and asserts the live-region text.

Full evidence chain (both personas, every variant of the write-feedback item): objectstack-ai/objectstack#24570.
